riskSignals.signal: Official allergen guidance is general and product-label based, not a location-specific matrix.
Configurable products can vary by selected flavor and topping; empty direct-allergen arrays remain unknown, not safe.

findings.finding: The complete official National Harbor menu contains 99 current nonalcoholic product presentations across seven populated menu groupings.
The frozen 25 rows include category headings, vendor-only size/configuration rows, stale presentations, and normalized descriptions rather than a complete current catalog.
